target_pattern: Distinguish existence (hay) from location of known objects (está/están), and place objects naturally using core Spanish prepositions of place.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one is/are structure for everything.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish separates existence (hay) from location of known things (está/están).
target_pattern_formula: El/La + noun + está ... (specific singular thing is located)
Los/Las + noun + están ... (specific plural things are located)
natural_examples: Hay una mesa en la cocina.
La mesa está en la cocina.
Las llaves están en el pasillo.
¿Hay una silla cerca de la ventana?

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using hay vs está/están correctly. No answer key until the end.
prompts_en: There is a dog in the yard.
The dog is in the yard.
There are shoes in the hallway.
The shoes are in the hallway.
There is a table in the kitchen.
The table is in the kitchen.
There are two chairs in the dining room.
The chairs are next to the table.
There is a lamp on the desk.
The lamp is on the desk.
There is a mirror in the bathroom.
The mirror is behind the door.
There are keys in my room.
The keys are inside the backpack.
There is a window in the office.
The window is to the right of the desk.
There are books on the bookshelf.
The books are near the bed.
There is no chair in the room.
The chair is outside the room.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Hay una lámpara en la sala. -> change to plural.
Base: La lámpara está sobre la mesa. -> make it a question.
Base: Hay zapatos en el pasillo. -> make it negative.
Base: Los zapatos están en el pasillo. -> change location to debajo de la cama.
Base: Hay una mesa en la cocina. -> ask where is the table in a second sentence.
Base: La mesa está en la cocina. -> change subject to plural las mesas.
Base: Hay un gato dentro de la caja. -> replace dentro de with fuera de.
Base: El gato está dentro de la caja. -> make it negative.
Base: Hay un banco enfrente de la iglesia. -> change banco to plural.
Base: El banco está entre el supermercado y la farmacia. -> change to los bancos.
Base: Hay un teléfono en el escritorio. -> change object to dos teléfonos.
Base: El teléfono está sobre el escritorio. -> rewrite with en.
Base: Hay una silla al lado de la ventana. -> turn into question.
Base: La silla está al lado de la ventana. -> move it to a la izquierda de la puerta.
Base: Hay una computadora en la oficina. -> follow with a location sentence for that same computer.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the most natural pattern and write in Spanish.
prompts: There is a table in the kitchen. (hay vs está)
The table is in the kitchen. (hay vs está)
There are books on the desk. (hay vs están)
The books are on the desk. (hay vs están)
Is there a pharmacy near here? (¿hay...? vs ¿está... una farmacia...?)
Where is the pharmacy? (¿dónde hay...? vs ¿dónde está...?) known specific place.
There is no bank on this street. (no hay vs no está) generic existence.
The bank is across from the church. (está vs hay) known location.
There are no keys in the bag. (no hay vs no están) unknown existence there.
The keys are not in the bag. (no están vs no hay) known keys.

common_errors.mistake: Using hay for known object location
common_errors.why_it_happens: Single strategy for all location sentences.
